title: Rav Zutrai

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 124b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.124b.12-14), objecting to a teaching that Rav Yehudah reported in Shmuel’s name. Hyman reports Mar Zutra from Dikdukei Soferim and Rav Zutra from all the old printings, attributing the Zutrai form to a corruption in the Frankfurt am Main printing.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Hebrew names Rav Zutra in the objection. The Davidson English spells it Rav Zutrai.
Hyman attributes Mar Zutra to Dikdukei Soferim and Rav Zutra to the older printings. He traces Zutrai to the Frankfurt am Main printing.
